missing_policy: complete required per score, otherwise null; product convention
source_note: Official scoring key printed in the paper's Appendix (administered form): 'All items were written in the positively keyed direction, so no reverse scoring of items is required. Curiosity score: the following items are summed: 3, 5, 6, 10, 12, 13. Decentering score: the following items are summed: 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 11.' Subscale sums 0-24 and 0-28; no total-score composition is given in the paper, so the two subscales are not combined. State measure: items refer to an immediately preceding meditation/practice session ('what you just experienced, just now'); do not mix with trait mindfulness scores. Any missing item yields null for that subscale (complete_required, product-conservative convention, not an author rule); no norms or cutoffs are invented. Form numbering 1-13 is the Appendix administered numbering (Table 1 EFA uses original pool numbers 06-42; mapping recorded in source.md).
